_comment: STAGE-D per-batch coverage registry -- batch 'source_coupling' (D12, Tier-2 source/frontend/mechanisms tier)
(docs/twin_validation/wave2_6_unit_test_contract.md SS12.3/12.4; full-coverage program;
work-list docs/twin_validation/l3_release_package_unit_inventory.md D12).
Run via tests/harness/gate.py <this file> (L0+L1; calls tests/harness/coverage_audit.py) and
tests/harness/mutation.py <this file> (L2).
MODULE: source/coupling.py -- the Axis-2 shared-source parameter fan-out Theta(z_t): one explicit
source draw conditions many mechanism parameters in the same cycle (static-ZZ frequency drift +
log-rate/logit maps + the P2-i Theta->leakage seam). It is a parameter LAYER, not a Stim/DEM noise
layer nor a channel assembler. The module imports NEITHER torch NOR quimb (numpy + math only), so
EVERY public unit is CPU-PURE and IN-SCOPE for full L0+L1+L2 -- out_of_scope is therefore {} (the
AST reconcile refuses any gpu_bound claim on a torch-less module).
TWENTY public units (AST reconcile: top-level public defs + every public method of a top-level class
+ the load-bearing __post_init__ dunder of each frozen dataclass):
* 11 module functions: default_source_coupling_config, source_to_params, trajectory_to_params,
independent_baseline_trajectory_to_params, parameter_series, cross_mechanism_correlation,
static_zz_zeta, exchange_j_from_phi, zz_phi_from_frequency_drift, drift_to_t2, leakage_from_drift.
* StaticZZCalibration (frozen dataclass, 5): __post_init__ + base_delta_radns, alpha_radns,
exchange_j_radns (properties) + to_manifest.
* SourceCouplingConfig (frozen dataclass, 2): __post_init__ + to_manifest.
* CoupledMechanismParams (frozen dataclass, 2): source_draw_for + to_manifest (no __post_init__).
CPU discipline. Every unit runs on numpy/math only -- no GPU touched. This is CLOSED-FORM physics, so
value-pins are the workhorse (METRICS-standard): every load-bearing number is pinned against a
from-scratch INDEPENDENT recompute of the analytic formula (the dispersive static-ZZ cross-Kerr
zeta = 2 J^2 [1/(D-a) - 1/(D+a)], the phi=zeta(J)*t_gate/4 inversion + its exact round-trip, the
positive-rate exp map base*exp(clamp(sens*x)), the logit map, and an independent Pearson recompute for
cross_mechanism_correlation) -- NEVER the module's own helper. No numerical-convergence parameter is
load-bearing (all maps are analytic), so the CONVERGENCE rule is satisfied trivially and no pin is
marked slow. Every validation RAISE asserts its EXACT message via str(excinfo.value)==... (mutmut wraps
roundtrips string literals -- a substring match= lets them survive, exact-equality kills them).
assert_discriminates gives each closed-form invariant a demonstrated sabotage variant it rejects
(wrong-sign zeta, dropped factor-4, exp-with-wrong-exponent, anti-correlated series, coupling-broken
independent baseline).
The module's PRIVATE helpers (_params_from_draws -- the key->field routing core, _modulate_positive_rate,
_modulate_probability_logit, _as_1d_finite, _validate_probability, _drift_to_T2 alias, and the _require_*
float guards) are NOT public units and are NOT reconciled/scored, but ARE exercised + mutation-covered
here via direct value-pins + exact-message raises (mutmut 3.6 is coverage-guided: every covered helper
line yields counted mutants, so each is given teeth -- notably a distinct-draw-per-key _params_from_draws
routing pin that kills every wrong-key mutation, and the [-60,60] exponent-clamp bounds).
NO exemptions + NO out_of_scope: every guard is REACHABLE (static_zz_zeta singular via D==+/-a; the two
exchange_j_from_phi raises via alpha=0 zero-coefficient and a sign-inconsistent phi<0; every __post_init__
validator via a sabotaged constructor arg; the _params_from_draws non-finite-draw raise via a nan draw),
so no defensive_assert exemption is warranted (contrast the D11 from_fixed_marginal dead guard).
